description:
Salad turns downtime into downloads. Run Salad whenever you're away from the keys to score games, gift cards, subscriptions, DLC, and more at the Salad Storefront.


Update to version 1.9.27:
- Fixes problems running AMD GPU workloads.
- Fixes an issue where a machine could fail to start any container workload indefinitely because of networking state left behind by an earlier container workload. Affected machines recover automatically after updating.
- Adds a live download progress bar, metrics, and status for container workload images.
- Adds a "Get Help" window to submit support tickets straight from the app with an option to attach helpful diagnostic data to accelerate support cases. Available from the profile menu on the main page and from the tray icon.
- Improves container workload tracking, correcting cases where a workload's status could be reported inaccurately after it finished.
- Improves utilization of the storage allocation to pre-cache workload images and get earning faster.
- Removes Star Chef.
- General maintenance and reliability improvements.
NVIDIA Edition
